<div class="card-body">
'''Biggs Darklighter''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ビッグズ・ダークライター</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋２。レッド３に乗れば、さらに回避が＋１され、戦闘運命値を引けない場合に、１枚だけ引ける。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-3o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ヤヴィンの戦いで、レッド３を操縦する。ルークの幼なじみ。ヘルメットのエンブレムは、ランド・エクリプティック号で反乱を起こし、造船所から盗み出したことの証。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Biggs Darklighter.

'''Card text:''' A starship he pilots is power +2. If aboard Red 3, also maneuver +1, and he may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

'''Lore:''' Pilots Red 3 at the Battle of Yavin. Luke's childhood friend. The emblem on his helmet marks the mutiny on the Rand Ecliptic and its theft from the shipyards.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Biggs Darklighter]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
